name: Event calendar
description: A month grid of events, deadlines or posts, with navigation, selection and adding per day.

classes.ayy-event-calendar__add: Add an event on this day.
classes.ayy-event-calendar__event: Event button with an optional colour.

default.looks: A seven-column month grid with events in their days.

hover.looks: The add button appears and the event tint deepens.

pressed.when: Press an event or navigation control

disabled.none: Use disabled controls when an action is unavailable.

selected.looks: An inset event-colour outline marks it.

error.none: Show an Alert for loading or saving errors.

loading.none: Render the month with Skeleton bars in the days.

today.looks: The date has a primary circle.

outside.looks: Its background and date are muted.

done.looks: Its title is struck through and muted.

sizes.density: Navigation and add controls follow density and size scope.
sizes.width: Seven equal columns fill the available width.

js: eventCalendarClass({ className? }); eventCalendarMonth({ month, events, today?, weekStart? }); eventCalendarLabels.

EventCalendar.renders: section with a month header and a 42-day event grid

props.events: EventCalendarEvent[] — events with id, date, title and optional time, color and done
props.month / defaultMonth: string — first of the shown month; month is controlled
props.today: string — today as an ISO date

a11y: The month title labels the grid; each day announces its full date and event count.
Events and add actions are buttons with visible focus.
do: Use an event calendar to show records on the days they happen.
Supply translated labels and a locale for the people using it.
dont: Don't use an event calendar to pick a single date — use Date picker.
